headline: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Switch 2 Edition December 3
title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Switch 2 Edition Release Date December 3 | New Hero | Gaming News
video_script: Xenoblade Chronicles three is getting a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on December third. It runs at four K and sixty frames per second in TV mode, and one thousand eighty p at sixty in handheld mode. It adds a new hero named Shimmer with a new quest, and a new mode called Heroes' Vault. Are you playing it again? Comment below!
description: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition launches December 3, 2026: 4K/60fps docked, 1080p/60fps handheld, new hero Shimmer and Heroes' Vault mode. Sources: Nintendo Life, Game Informer, Gematsu.
